policy: Sol, Tavi and Mia are the permanent main trio. Each new level or book may introduce no more than one new guest character to join them and teach one memorable lesson. A previous guest may reappear only when that lesson is relevant, through a natural story encounter or an optional hint earned after a genuine attempt. A callback may recall a method but must never state or expose the new answer.

main_cast.name: Mia
main_cast.role: visible child guide and journey narrator

callback_guardrails: No level or book introduces more than one new guest character.
A returning guest appears only when their earlier lesson is relevant.
A returning character asks or demonstrates; they do not solve the new task.
Narrative callbacks must make sense even when the player does not remember the earlier level.
Hint callbacks unlock only after an attempt or through an optional book code.
No required lesson, answer or route is locked behind remembering a character.

guest_characters.name: Nori
guest_characters.lesson_memory: Listen within a short check and name what was heard without inventing a sound.
guest_characters.return_rule: Bring Nori back only when careful listening is relevant. Nori may ask what the player heard, but cannot identify the new answer.

guest_characters.name: Pax
guest_characters.lesson_memory: Check that every exact part is present once, with no gap, overlap or extra part.
guest_characters.return_rule: Bring Pax back only when checking parts and wholes is relevant. Pax may ask the player to check each part, but cannot identify a new answer.

guest_characters.name: Vee
guest_characters.lesson_memory: Name the two roles, make one declared move, compare what changed and keep a broken try visible while repairing it.
guest_characters.return_rule: Bring Vee back only when a declared two-role pattern or lawful next move is relevant. Vee may ask the player to name the rule and check one move, but cannot identify the new answer.

guest_characters.name: Ivo
guest_characters.role: garden helper who likes to check twice
guest_characters.lesson_memory: Look at the picture plan, keep a wrong sign visible, follow the move cards in order, measure side to side and bottom to top, and make a second sign without peeking.
guest_characters.return_rule: Bring Ivo back only when looking again, measuring or checking without peeking is relevant. Ivo may ask what the child can point to or check next, but cannot identify the new answer.
